title: The Trinity test as the hinge point that drew the phenomenon

tellings.quote: unable to destroy itself. Then on July 16th, 1945, in a stretch of New Mexico desert, Oenheimer named Trinity.

plain: On July 16, 1945, in the New Mexico desert, the physicist J. Robert Oppenheimer's team set off the first atomic bomb, a test Oppenheimer named Trinity, and Michels frames it as the turning point that drew the UFO phenomenon to Earth. He tells it himself, without naming a source, in an episode about Air Force veterans who say they were abducted, as if humanity's new power to destroy itself caught someone's attention.
